prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Lawrencium (Lr) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: the crest walkway of a hydroelectric dam, a steel railing, spillway gates and a wide reservoir below
Weather / season: autumn — falling leaves and warm low light outside.
Time of day: an overcast day — soft, shadowless grey-white light; soft even light, colours calm, no hard shadows.
Hair: her hair tied up in a loose bun or ponytail — same colour and length as the attached image, a few strands loose.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a tight tube top under an open cropped cardigan with glossy high-waisted leggings that outline the hips and legs — in denim blue with crisp white; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 80-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 60-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque; styled with close-fitting ribbed fabric, a close, neatly tailored fit and a silk ribbon tied in her hair; right now — she wears her top half undone — the zip or the top buttons open much lower than usual, so the neckline falls open over her collarbones and the inner curve of her chest, the loose edges slipping apart, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the left of the frame; camera at her eye level; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she holds a palm-sized ring of bronze and glass with a faint blue-violet light circling inside it in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one brow raised higher, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — lawrencium: a synthetic metal first made in 1961 in a hillside laboratory by striking californium with boron ions, and named for the inventor of the cyclotron, a round machine in which particles spiral between the poles of a great magnet, kicked a little faster on every turn, grown from a first ring of glass and bronze small enough to sit in a palm to rings the size of a building; the last of the fifteen actinides at the very end of the bottom row of the table, its first symbol later rewritten, its longest-lived form lasting about half a day, and the one of its row that gives up its outermost electron most easily — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
acceptance: User authorized original generation results, QA and normal main publication without further confirmation

generation.note: Generated once and retained unchanged; only standard size normalization and WebP encoding applied.

observations: Reference world image was attached; copper hair, freckles, violet eyes and painterly anime rendering retained.
One main woman, natural connected limbs; visible hands reviewed without an obvious extra limb.
World armour and crown removed. Element motif details are extensively reinterpreted in outfit and surroundings.
Image aspect matches plan; standardized dimensions verified.
An open cardigan is added over the planned tube top.
